name: Scrollbar
author: Themepoints

sections.description:
Scrollbar wp is fully customizable WordPress scrollbar plugin. You can change scrollbar color, border radius, scroll speed, width, border style & other settings using plugin option page.

Scrollbar by https://themepoints.com

  • Live demo!»

Plugin Features

  • Simple installation & activation
  • Unlimited colors.
  • CSS3 animation.
  • Supported touch devices.
  • All browser supported
  • Custom Width.
  • Scrollbar border radius.
  • Scrollbar scroll speed.
  • Scrollbar border.
  • Auto Hide Mode Enable/Disable.
  • Lightweight.
  • Easy Option Panel.
  • Easy Documentation.
sections.installation:
1. Install as regular WordPress plugin.
  2. Go your Pluings setting via WordPress Dashboard and activate it.
  3. After activate plugin you will see “Scrollbar Wp” menu at left side on WordPress dashboard and find “Scrollbar Option Settings”
sections.changelog:
2.0.9

  • Security Enhancement: Implemented rigorous nonce verification (wp_nonce_field and wp_verify_nonce) across the settings form to fully protect against CSRF vulnerabilities.
  • WordPress Coding Standards: Added strict sanitization callbacks (sanitize_hex_color, absint, and custom boolean validation) to all register_setting() calls, resolving all Plugin Check validation errors.
  • Asset Loading Optimization: Refactored admin script and style enqueuing to load the WordPress color picker strictly on the plugin’s dedicated settings page (admin_enqueue_scripts), preventing global script conflicts.
  • Form & Capability Hardening: Added explicit capability checks (current_user_can('manage_options')) and robust handling for $_POST array indices to prevent undefined notices and secure data processing.
  • UI Refinements: Streamlined markup in the admin options template and updated the JavaScript initialization to ensure secure attribute escaping and reliable rendering.
